stem: After transplant, the surrounding media is consistently moist but the original propagation plug dries much faster. What is the strongest investigation?
choices: Check the wetting pattern and hydraulic contact between the plug and surrounding media, then adjust irrigation placement if needed
Increase fertilizer concentration throughout the room
Assume the plug and surrounding media always hold water identically
rationale: Different media interfaces can wet and dry differently. Evaluating contact and irrigation placement helps determine whether the active root ball is receiving water even when the surrounding media appears moist.
